case_number: 2024 INSC 831; Special Leave Petition (C) No.8541 of 2024; Special Leave Petition (C) No.7857 of 2024; Special Leave Petition (C) No.7821 of 2024; Special Leave Petition (C) No.7878 of 2024; Special Leave Petition (C) No.7890 of 2024; Special Leave Petition (C) No.13038 of 2024; Transfer Petition (C) No.2697 of 2024
summary: Constitutional validity of Uttar Pradesh Board of Madarsa Education Act, 2004; challenged under secularism, Articles 14, 21A; legislative competence under Entry 25, List III upheld; conflict with UGC Act (Entry 66) acknowledged but partial invalidation adopted; Act held regulatory, not violative of basic structure; High Court judgment setting aside Act partially reversed.
legal_provisions_cited: Constitution of India, 1950 Art.14, Art.21A, Art.30
Uttar Pradesh Board of Madarsa Education Act, 2004
final_judgment: High Court's invalidation reversed in part; Madarsa Act upheld subject to repugnant provisions to UGC Act; impugned judgment set aside.
